about: Quiz Island (Henry, Nov 18; new rules Nov 19): Race Board's quiz on an island map; points are gold. Questions come from Race Board's bank (games/race-board/content.json), Quiz Battle's sets (via kru-quiz.js) or the unit picked on the setup screen. Only the How to play slides live here.

intro.title: Quiz Island
text: One team at a time answers a question.
Right answer: claim an island and its gold!

intro.title: Big answers, big rewards
text: Hard or Impossible right? Your team picks one reward:

intro.title: Secret islands
text: Some islands hide a secret. Good or bad?
You find out when you land on one!

intro.title: 🏰 Fortresses
text: One fortress per team. Nobody can sink or steal it,
or your islands next to it!

intro.title: Power-ups
text: Pirate Raid: right = sink, steal or 2 islands. Wrong = lose 2!

intro.title: Always guess!
text: Wrong answer: no gold lost. No answer: −3 gold!
At the end, the biggest group of islands gets +10.
